scope: D3D9 SetRenderTarget rejects interfaces outside this frontend and surfaces owned by another device before resolving host handles, retaining/releasing references, replacing slots, emitting commands or changing viewport/scissor. Preserve same-device target/cube/backbuffer behavior and same-object rebinding. This ownership check is a prerequisite for the pending separation of public and internal binding references. D3D8 already checks frontend/owner and is retained as a regression control. Depth binding ownership, native public binding counters/device pins, unsupported color/depth combinations, complete Reset/multiple buffers/thread/device loss, original Microsoft HAL, games/FPS and review stages 4/5/6 remain open. Foreign-interface rejection is this proxy policy, not a claim about arbitrary COM wrappers on native D3D9. Host/protocol/shaders unchanged; no draw/Present/Reset or GPU pixel run.

sources.evidence: Pinned d3d9_device_SetRenderTarget rejects a surface whose creating device differs before acquiring a render-target view or changing state. Accepted targets update the viewport only for slot zero. This is a source implementation reference; no original Microsoft HAL cross-device run is claimed.

documentation.evidence: Invalid render targets return INVALIDCALL. Successful slot-zero target changes set the full-target viewport.
